environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: LSSI provider disclosure is material if the site is a Spanish-targeted information-society service; operator and establishment facts are missing.
expected: The release contains approved, permanent, easy, direct and free access to the applicable provider identity and registration information.
observed: The repository has no approved operator name, tax identifier, address, registry data, sector authorisation or legal notice.
method: Static repository and client-document review; official BOE source check.
preconditions: No operator identity was inferred from project-management roles.
limitations: No corporate records, domain ownership record or final legal service classification were supplied.
impact: A public commercial site could omit mandatory provider disclosures or publish invented/wrong identity data.
prevalence: Release-wide legal footer and legal notice.

source_refs.legal_effect: Spanish provider-information duties within LSSI scope.
source_refs.version: BOE consolidated text; last update observed 2025-01-23
source_refs.applicability_reason: The project plans a public Spanish commercial contact site; operator scope still requires confirmation.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE consolidated text and applicability review.

false_positive_analysis: A legal notice cannot be assessed for substantive accuracy because no operator facts were provided; absence is nevertheless a release blocker in the planned scope.
counterevidence: The site is not deployed and remains disallow-all/noindex.
remediation_minimum: Identify the legal operator and provide verified identity, establishment, contact, registry and sector data; have counsel approve the original legal notice before enabling publication.
additional_hardening: Version the identity evidence and add a release test that every approved legal route is present before indexing.
retest: Verify the final legal notice against source documents and the public footer on the release build.
residual_risk: NO-GO until operator and scope are confirmed; do not fill with placeholders.
